scenes.title: Moses Called to the Tabernacle
scenes.caption: The Lord calls to Moses from the Tabernacle. He tells Moses to instruct the Israelites about bringing offerings from their cattle or flock.
scenes.visualPrompt: Moses stands respectfully outside the entrance of the Tabernacle, listening intently. The Tabernacle is a large, ornate tent structure in a desert setting. The sky is clear. No other people are visible.

scenes.title: Burnt Offering from the Herd
scenes.caption: A man brings a male bullock without blemish to the Tabernacle door. He places his hand on its head. A priest kills the bullock, sprinkles its blood on the altar, and prepares the animal for burning. The priest then burns the prepared parts on the altar.
scenes.visualPrompt: A man in simple Israelite clothing stands next to a large bullock at the entrance of the Tabernacle courtyard. He has one hand on the bullock's head. In the background, a priest, dressed in linen garments, is tending to a fire on a large stone altar. The mood is solemn and ritualistic.

scenes.title: Burnt Offering from the Flock
scenes.caption: If the offering is from the flock, a man brings a male sheep or goat without blemish. A priest kills it on the north side of the altar and sprinkles its blood. The priest then prepares the animal and burns it on the altar.
scenes.visualPrompt: A man in simple Israelite clothing stands with a sheep or goat on the north side of a large stone altar in the Tabernacle courtyard. A priest, dressed in linen garments, is performing a ritual action with the animal. Smoke rises from the altar in the background. The setting is the Tabernacle courtyard under a clear sky.

scenes.title: Burnt Offering from Fowls
scenes.caption: If the offering is of fowls, a man brings turtledoves or young pigeons. A priest prepares the bird by wringing its head and casting its crop and feathers aside. The priest then burns the bird on the altar.
scenes.visualPrompt: A priest, dressed in linen garments, stands at the altar in the Tabernacle courtyard, holding a small bird (dove or pigeon). He is performing a ritual action with the bird. Another priest might be tending the fire on the altar. The mood is solemn.
